summary: Tested windows app bug fixes + static site deliverable per review. Results: windows_app pytest 27/27 PASS (incl. new quickassist_default_trusted migration tests). gui_smoke.py prints 'GUI SMOKE PASS' - confirms (a) 6 identical remote_block events coalesce into 1 WarningScreen + 1 log entry, (b) a single 'I understand' click closes it, (c) StatusPage scroll area shows 30 findings scrollable. parity_test.py 30/30 identical (static site linkcheck == python). Backend regression test_backend_api.py 13/13 PASS. Static site at {BASE}/site/index.html: nav-coffee-link href=https://buymeacoffee.com/trcmsp target=_blank, footer-coffee-link, mobile menu (390px) opens with coffee+download links, no horizontal overflow (sw=cw=390). Link checker runs fully client-side: empty submit -> 'Paste a link or message first' toast; preset 0 -> 'Dangerous - do not click' (risk 100/100); preset 3 -> 'Looks safe'. Warning preview: simulate-popup-button opens overlay, close button enables ~3s later and ONE click closes it. Install tabs switch (rmm-tab aria-selected=true), rmm-copy-* shows 'Command copied' toast. faq-trigger-0 expands <details>. All 5 download buttons point to the expected github.com/trcmsp/simple-scam-protection/releases/latest/download/* URLs (404 until release published - expected, not reported). SEO files present: robots.txt, sitemap.xml, 404.html, .htaccess, canonical link in index.html.
critical_code_review_comments: gui.py WarningScreen.update_message/close pattern + is_repeat() 20s dedupe correctly fixes the 'click several times' bug by ensuring only one warning window is ever open per event family. Verified by gui_smoke firing 6 identical remote_block events -> exactly 1 window, 1 log entry.

StatusPage ScrollArea uses Canvas + ttk.Scrollbar + mouse wheel binding; on Windows, event.delta is used (standard +/-120 units). Code looks correct for Windows; on Linux Button-4/Button-5 fallback is also wired, so cross-platform OK.

storage.py migration flag quickassist_default_trusted is idempotent: new users get Quick Assist trusted by default, existing users get it auto-trusted on first launch after upgrade, and if the user later untrusts it the flag prevents re-trusting (verified by the 27 pytest tests).
Static site link checker is a straight port of windows_app/linkcheck.py and parity_test.py confirms 30/30 identical verdicts/scores - no divergence risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 bugs/features from the review request verified green on both Linux (via Xvfb for gui_smoke) and in the browser preview. The 'download-*' buttons will 404 against GitHub until the user publishes a release - this is expected and NOT a bug. Preview URL for static site: https://seraph-secure-copy.preview.emergentagent.com/site/index.html. Known pystray 'Failed to dock icon / AssertionError' tracebacks when running gui_smoke on Linux are expected (no system tray in Xvfb) and do not fail the smoke test.
